name: NovaStar VX4S / NovaPro HD / MCTRL4K
notes: NovaStar binary protocol over TCP 5200, frames from the Bitfocus Companion 'novastar-controller' module (2.6), which uses these display-mode frames for VX4S, NovaPro HD and MCTRL4K. VX1000, VX16S, VX Pro, J6 and NovaPro UHD Jr have their own profile, and so does VX600. VX6S is not covered: the module's frames for it are all the same, so try this profile and check. No test pattern off or identify/locate command is known.
